verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekagandhampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, itthigandho.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single smell that occupies a man’s mind like the smell of a woman.

verses.pali: Itthigandho, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The smell of a woman occupies a man’s mind.”
